preset_name: VHS Restoration - Stage 2: Upscaling & Re-Texturing (Proteus v4)
description: Second pass: Upscale cleaned Stage 1 output 2x and add film grain to mask AI smoothness.
use_case: Upscale VHS from 720x480 → 1440x1080 (or 960x720 for poor quality tape)
input: Stage 1 cleaned output (from Iris LQ pass)

revert_compression.tooltip: Cleaning is done. Keep low to preserve Stage 1 work.

sharpen.tooltip: Push sharpening to define edges in 1440x1080.

dehalo.tooltip: Minor halo cleanup. Iris already handled most of it.

anti_alias_deblur.tooltip: Negative = anti-aliasing. Lock down newly upscaled edges.

add_noise_grain_amount.tooltip: CRITICAL. VHS has no true detail. Grain tricks eye into perceiving sharpness.

why_grain_is_essential: VHS original has almost zero high-frequency detail. Drenching the upscaled frame in 16mm-style fine grain masks smooth AI transitions and makes the image feel more organic. Without grain, VHS upscales look plastic.

output_resolution_choice.1440x1080: For SP 2-hour mode tape. Standard quality VHS.
output_resolution_choice.960x720: For EP/SLP 6-hour mode tape. Very poor quality, lots of degradation.
output_resolution_choice.avoid_higher: Never upscale VHS beyond 1440x1080. You'll invent pores and fake eyelashes.

why_not_4x: 1x stage → 4x is 4x upscale total. That's too aggressive. Go 1x → 2x (moderate), not 1x → 4x (hallucination).
common_mistakes: Skipping Stage 1 (trying to upscale dirty VHS directly—hallucinations)
Disabling grain (output looks plastic and synthetic)
Setting Sharpen above 40 (creates ringing and artifacts)
Over-recovery of detail (VHS has none; don't force it)

testing.step_1: Render 10 seconds on RTX 4070 (should take ~2 min)
testing.step_3: Play in VLC—look for grain texture
testing.step_4: If output looks plastic, increase grain to 5
testing.step_5: If output looks muddy, lower grain to 3

expected_output: 1440x1080 @ 60fps, visible 16mm film grain, sharp edges, no plastic skin, organic feel, no hallucinated details

post_processing.optional: Add slight vignette or color grading to enhance 'archival' aesthetic
post_processing.audio: Separately restore audio (remove tape hiss, level out dynamics)
post_processing.delivery: Output as H.265 HEVC 10-bit for archival and streaming
